speaker: richard_field
text: Will? Richard Field. From my own shop, with a book open that I did not print.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. I am not yet in a gown.

speaker: richard_field
text: It came yesterday in a parcel from Cambridge. A learned thing in quarto. A letter in it from England to her three daughters, the two universities and the Inns of Court, praising their poets by the yard. I was reading it for the workmanship, which is middling.

speaker: richard_field
text: And on one leaf, in the margin, small, there's a name I know. I'll not tell thee what he calls thee. Come and see it with thine own eyes. Harrison has copies at the Greyhound by this. Tomorrow, ten, at Paul's.

speaker: richard_field
text: He does not. That's why I'd have thee read it standing by an honest man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My jaw is the size of an egg, and I am not fit to be praised.

speaker: richard_field
text: Then it will do thee good. Woburn in Bedfordshire burned on Saturday, and a stationer is already rushing a godly tract on it through the press. Tell thy Quiney to send up his town's certificate before Woburn has drunk every charitable purse in England.
